root_cause.text: In `scsi_alloc_sdev()`, when `scsi_realloc_sdev_budget_map()` fails, the function returns without releasing the previously acquired reference on `tagset_refcnt`, causing a reference count leak that blocks SCSI host teardown.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `kref_put(&sdev->host->tagset_refcnt, scsi_mq_free_tags)` call in the error path after `scsi_realloc_sdev_budget_map()` fails (see the one-line addition). The CVE description and commit message explicitly state this refcount leak leads to a hang during `scsi_remove_host()`.
